docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Edwin Arnold’s verse rendering of Jayadeva’s Gītagovinda, the Sanskrit lyric of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, with his introduction (London, 1875). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Indian Song of songs : From the Sanskrit of the Gîta Govinda of Jayadeva · Jayadeva, 12th cent, Arnold, Edwin, Sir, 1832-1904 · 1875, 172 scanned pages. Published 1875; Edwin Arnold died 1904; the poem is of the twelfth century; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
